212 AM PDT Tue Oct 27 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1023 mb high was 400 nautical miles west of San 
Francisco and a 1013 mb low covered the northern Gulf of 
California. A weak offshore land breeze is expected near shore 
during the nights and mornings, with onshore flow prevailing 
each afternoon and evening through Thursday. An intermittent  
coastal eddy will circulate Wednesday and Thursday. Weak westerly
onshore flow Friday will increase Saturday.

$$
